title: Sleep and Learning
text:
Sleep plays a crucial role in memory consolidation. During the night, the brain replays information acquired during the day. Consequently, students who sleep well often recall material more accurately. Nevertheless, many young people regularly sacrifice sleep for late-night study.

Researchers have found that short naps can also improve learning. For example, a twenty-minute nap may enhance alertness in the afternoon. Moreover, the benefits are strongest when the nap is taken before new material is studied. In contrast, long naps can leave people feeling groggy.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what does the brain do during the night?
options: It replays information acquired during the day
It prepares the body for physical exercise

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what effect may a twenty-minute nap have?
options: It may enhance alertness in the afternoon

questions.text: What does the writer imply by using 'Nevertheless' in paragraph one?
options: Students' habits can undermine the benefits of sleep just described
Sleep has no effect on memory
Late-night study is the best approach to learning
Young people never study at night

questions.text: What can be inferred about the timing of naps from paragraph two?
options: Naps are most useful when taken before studying new material
Naps should always be longer than an hour
Naps are useful only after studying
Naps prevent people from learning anything

vocabulary.definition: the process of making memories stable and long-lasting
the state of being quick to notice things and respond to them
feeling weak, confused and sleepy, especially after waking up
in addition to what has just been said

paragraph_translations: Сон відіграє вирішальну роль у закріпленні пам'яті. Уночі мозок прокручує інформацію, отриману протягом дня. Отже, студенти, які добре висипаються, часто згадують матеріал точніше. Проте багато молодих людей регулярно жертвують сном заради нічного навчання.

Дослідники з'ясували, що короткий денний сон також може покращувати навчання. Наприклад, двадцятихвилинний сон може підвищувати пильність після обіду. Крім того, користь найбільша тоді, коли сон відбувається до вивчення нового матеріалу. На відміну від цього, тривалий сон може залишити людей розбитими.
